function_v0.doc:
Grants the achievement to `to`.

Design choice (CosmosX): we require `to.require_auth()`, NOT the
admin's. This means the *player's own connected wallet* must sign
their own claim \xe2\x80\x94 the on-stage demo flow where the player presses
"Claim" and approves it in Freighter. Nobody can mint an achievement
to an address that didn't itself authorize the call.
function_v0.name: mint

function_v0.doc: Read-only: who is the admin (deployer/owner) of this contract?
function_v0.name: get_admin

function_v0.doc: Runs once, right after deployment, to record who deployed/owns this\ncontract. Panics if called a second time so the admin can't be\nsilently reassigned after setup.
function_v0.name: initialize
